messages:
sasha: quick thread 1 drafting a compact DP/beta entry checklist so PMs and ops have deterministic gates. want short convo and owners.

marcos: sounds good. what are the top 3 validation goals?

sasha: 1) onboarding friction for Dedicated/Private; 2) routing + rollback behavior under regional failover; 3) high-signal paired-eval prompts for model tuning.

tana: propose acceptance gates: enrollment, first inference within 48h, paired-eval baseline, routing exercise, and observability enabled. keep it binary where possible.

priya: agree. add requirement that partners provide 10 representative prompt pairs and an infra contact before kickoff. also weekly 20-min syncs mandatory.

kevin: ops note 1 reserve a labeled buffer pool (dp-beta-reserve) X-3 days prior. also limit exposed model variants to 2 to reduce blast radius.

sasha: draft ACs below 1 please quick reactions.

```
ENTRY CHECKLIST (DP/BETA, compact)
- Commit: partner signs invite & schedules kickoff within 7d
- Onboard: first successful inference <=48h of activation
- Prompts: partner submits 10 prompt pairs within 72h of selection
- Paired-eval: 50-sample human preference test; baseline win-rate >=90% OR <=10pp regression
- Routing: fallback exercised in staging at least twice and reproduced in runbook
- Observability: token-level latency + per-route error visible in Console
- Feedback: weekly 20-min sync + 5-question micro-survey after each sync
```

marcos: nit 1 change wording to "committed/active split": commit 8, expect 6 active to account for dropouts.

tana: owner suggestions: marcos = invites + partner comms, priya = intake + paired-eval rubric, kevin = ops reserve, sasha = coordinator.

priya: blocker: need a tiny ingestion script to normalize partner prompts into eval harness format. ETA 3 days if prioritized.

kevin: blocker: current GPU quota has one maintenance window overlapping our earliest proposed kickoff. i can escalate but timeline uncertain.

sasha: plan: outreach this week, lock owners, reserve capacity once we have 4 commitments, kickoff target in 3 weeks. i'll send invite draft tomorrow.

(dp-bot): Ticket BETA-505 created: "dp-entry-checklist-compact" (assignee: sasha).
